test_deprecate_kwarg: test the deprecate_kwarg decorator that renames an old keyword argument to a new one with a FutureWarning
test_dict_mapping_deprecate_kwarg: test the deprecate_kwarg decorator with a dict mapping that transforms old keyword argument values to new values
test_callable_mapping_deprecate_kwarg: test the deprecate_kwarg decorator with a callable mapping that transforms old keyword argument values
test_deprecate_kwarg_unchanged_name: test the deprecate_kwarg decorator that issues a warning while keeping the argument name unchanged
test_deprecate_kwarg_invalid_mapping: test that deprecate_kwarg raises TypeError when given an invalid mapping type
